findings.title: Reject path traversal in the slice identifier
findings.description: `_nonempty` only trims and rejects blank input, but `slice_id` is used directly in `start_file` and `baseline_file` to construct paths. A value such as `../../target` can make `record_start_and_baselines` write state files outside the notes directory. Validate the identifier as a slice number or otherwise ensure the resolved paths remain inside `NOTES_DIR`.

findings.title: Do not treat unknown catch-up status as caught up
findings.description: `caught_up` is `None` when the family’s source edge is unknown, but this guard returns an empty report for every value other than `False`. That can suppress the not-caught-up evidence and failures even when coverage contains incomplete sessions. Treat unknown catch-up status as a stop or evaluate the sessions rather than silently skipping them.

findings.title: Include unheld provider spend in the suggested 30-day ceiling
findings.description: The suggested cap is rounded from `planned + trailing`, but the spend guard also includes unheld provider jobs in its 30-day total. When those jobs cause a cap refusal, the printed command can still set a cap too low to allow the purchase. Include the estimate’s unheld-job costs in the suggested cap calculation.
